verdicts.originalText: Two-stage cast, auto-resolved on the timeline. The first Skill press enters Essential Transmutation (a 6s window; this press starts the 12s cooldown) and deals no damage. Recasting the Skill within that window commits to Confirmation of Purity (a single AoE Pyro hit — the support form); pressing Normal Attack instead commits to Denial of Darkness (3 front Pyro hits — the damage form). The chosen form lasts 30s and decides which Burst Durin casts: E E → White, E N → Dark.
verdicts.proposedText: The opening press deals no damage and starts the 12s CD. A second E commits to the White (support) form; a Normal Attack commits to the Dark (damage) form instead — the chosen form lasts 30s and sets which Burst you get.
verdicts.rationale: Keeps the two decision-relevant facts a player needs to drive the planner: the opening press deals no damage (potential surprise) and how notation selects each form (E E vs E N), which sets the Burst. Drops the 'auto-resolved' framing (working behavior) and the per-commit hit descriptions (kit detail shown via frames). Notation tokens the user types are the allowed exception.

verdicts.originalText: White form only: while the Dragon of White Flame is active, the reacting opponent's Pyro RES and the RES of the other element in the reaction are each reduced by 20% for 6s. With 2 or more Hexenzirkel members on the team the reduction is 35% instead — not modeled here. In the Dark form this passive instead raises Durin's own Vaporize and Melt DMG by 40% (a reaction-damage bonus with no stat to display, so it is not shown).
verdicts.proposedText: The RES shred applies in the White form only; with 2 or more Hexenzirkel members on the team it deepens from 20% to 35%, which is not modeled. In the Dark form this passive instead gives +40% Vaporize and Melt DMG, which has no stat to show.
verdicts.rationale: The base RES shred (Pyro plus the reaction partner element) is authored and shown, so its description is working behavior; the two genuine omissions are kept — the faction-count upgrade to 35% (faction-count value swaps are an unwired gap) and the Dark-form Vaporize/Melt bonus (a reaction-DMG bonus with no display stat, FROZEN territory, so keep as not-shown rather than implementDelete).

verdicts.originalText: White form: all other party members gain Cycle of Enlightenment stacks for 20s; each of their N/C/P/E/Q hits consumes a stack to add flat DMG equal to 60% of Durin's ATK. Dark form: Durin himself gains the stacks and each Burst hit consumes 2 for +150% of his ATK. The bonus is flat DMG that scales off Durin's ATK and applies across every attack type, which has no single stat to represent — so it is not shown as a buff bar.
verdicts.proposedText: Not shown: a flat DMG bonus scaling off ATK — in the White form, teammates' N/C/P/E/Q hits each add 60% of ATK; in the Dark form, the caster's own Burst hits add 150%. It spans all attack types, with no single stat to represent it.
verdicts.rationale: A real omission: source-ATK-scaled flat DMG added across all attack types has no matching buff stat, so it cannot render as a bar. Keeps the White/Dark who-and-how-much (decision-relevant scope) and drops the stack lifetime and consumption counts as kit detail. 'Teammates' preserves the teamExcludingSelf scope without saying 'team'.
